gist.summary: Added Model Match to the games catalog. In each of five rounds, players read an anonymous answer and guess which of four AI models wrote it. All 96 answers were pre-generated with the Pollinations API, so playing requires no API key or API calls.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art game room, four answer cards sit beside a covered model name while Polli studies them through tiny detective glasses; pixel flowers grow around the table. Polli, the main character, is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings. She is small-to-medium sized within the scene, never oversized or dominating it. Strictly pixel art style, never realistic. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with prominent lime green (#ecf874) and dark purple (#110518) outlines.
